1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent no.3 to expedite the reference proceedings under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: We are not aware of number of cases pending before the said Authority and, therefore, we decline to issue any direction.
We leave it open to the petitioner to make such request before the Authority.
